baseline.aggregation: Page baselines combine canonical and .html variants; page totals must not be used as property totals.

observation.rule: Below either gate: inconclusive, no expansion. These are operational gates, not statistical significance. Even above them, inspect comparable query/country/device/rank strata before any attribution.

variable: English meta description only on two existing tool pages; titles and body are unchanged. Homepage navigation is a separate usability change, not a randomized SEO test.
design: Non-randomized observation controls have different query intent; no causal lift claim. Google may rewrite snippets.
